purpose: Status-labelled evidence retrieval for Personal, Work and Health CSI demonstrations.

query_fields.q: Optional free-text search over public-safe card fields.
query_fields.statuses: Evidence status filter. Demo defaults to approved + provisional.
query_fields.source_ids: Optional explicit evidence IDs; preserves caller order.
query_fields.limit: Maximum evidence cards returned after demo ranking.

response.evidence: Public-safe evidence-card array with status labels.

status_semantics.approved: Human-reviewed evidence in the approved seed release.
status_semantics.provisional: Screening-level evidence available for demos and hypothesis generation but not approved scientific claims.
status_semantics.excluded: Boundary/scope record; never returned by the demo client as recommendation evidence.

consumer_rule: CSI demos may display provisional evidence only when the evidence status is visible. Production claims-safe CSI outputs must use the approved Gateway relation.
